|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 2026-08-11 | Long | 20 | $238.50 | breakout | Base breakout on volume | **+$230** (+4.8%) |
| **2** | 2026-09-08 | Long | 15 | $262.00 | pullback | Added on the 20-day | **−$180** (−4.6%) |

Which should I close at $250?

- **Trade #2** (the pullback add)
